## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive (Internal Rotation). Confirmations: cyclicals/materials and healthcare showing multiple ABOVE TREND names while mega-cap Tech is broadly BELOW TREND; Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5). MAJOR Divergence: multiple large-cap techs BELOW TREND suppress strong directional calls—watch for trend break.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Materials lead: DD ABOVE TREND (1W: +187.38% | 1M: +178.61%) and broad Materials strength. Healthcare strong: ABBV ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.90% | 1M: +14.09%), TMO ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.54% | 1M: +12.96%). Industrials strong: CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.58% | 1M: +16.34%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -7.03% | 1M: -10.76%), MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -6.88% | 1M: -15.19%), ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -16.93% | 1M: -21.03%). Consumer Discretionary weak: AMZN BELOW TREND (1W: -4.42% | 1M: -14.43%), TSLA BELOW TREND (1W: -5.36% | 1M: -13.49%). Communication weak: NFLX BELOW TREND (1W: -7.87% | 1M: -19.14%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: DD ABOVE TREND (1W: +187.38% | 1M: +178.61%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +46.85%), CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.58% | 1M: +16.34%), ABBV ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.90% | 1M: +14.09%), INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.72% | 1M: +7.57%). Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5). Style: Value/Cyclical tilt.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: NFLX BELOW TREND (1W: -7.87% | 1M: -19.14%), BLK BELOW TREND (1W: -8.08% | 1M: -9.28%), PFE BELOW TREND (1W: -8.68% | 1M: -8.43%), FCX BELOW TREND (1W: -9.06% | 1M: -2.42%), NEM BELOW TREND (1W: -9.77% | 1M: -14.37%). Weakness concentrated in select Financials and Materials names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: DD (1W: +187.38% | 1M: +178.61%), AMAT (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +46.85%), CAT (1W: +10.58% | 1M: +16.34%), INTC (1W: +9.72% | 1M: +7.57%), TMO (1W: +9.54% | 1M: +12.96%). Note MAJOR Divergence: mega-cap Tech cluster (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, GOOGL, META, AMZN, TSLA) are all BELOW TREND—tactical risk to broad momentum.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed to weak; leadership narrow with semiconductors outperforming but mega-cap software/social under pressure. AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +46.85%) and INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.72% | 1M: +7.57%) versus AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -7.03% | 1M: -10.76%) and MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -6.88% | 1M: -15.19%); sector 1W: -2.62%.

8. Financials Outlook?
Mixed/neutral: JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.50% | 1M: +9.25%) and V ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.04% | 1M: +1.24%) offset by BLK BELOW TREND (1W: -8.08% | 1M: -9.28%) and CME BELOW TREND (1W: -10.91% | 1M: -19.95%); sector 1W: -0.27% and showing internal dispersion.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Constructive overall with several leaders: ABBV ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.90% | 1M: +14.09%), TMO ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.54% | 1M: +12.96%), DHR ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.69% | 1M: +11.80%) while PFE BELOW TREND (1W: -8.68% | 1M: -8.43%); sector 1W: +3.61%.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclicals and select healthcare: CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.58% | 1M: +16.34%), DD ABOVE TREND (1W: +187.38% | 1M: +178.61%), ABBV ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.90% | 1M: +14.09%); reduce exposure to mega-cap Tech concentration risk—AAPL, MSFT, NVDA all BELOW TREND. Style: Value/Cyclical tilt while monitoring tech divergence.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +46.85%), CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.58% | 1M: +16.34%), DD ABOVE TREND (1W: +187.38% | 1M: +178.61%). BEARISH: NFLX BELOW TREND (1W: -7.87% | 1M: -19.14%), ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -16.93% | 1M: -21.03%), PFE BELOW TREND (1W: -8.68% | 1M: -8.43%).

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Materials (1W: +16.20%; breadth strong within sector) and Healthcare (1W: +3.61%; multiple ABOVE TREND names). BEARISH: Technology (1W: -2.62%; mega-cap weakness) and Communication Services (1W: -0.35%; concentrated downside).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Monitor CAT for continuation above recent highs (ABOVE TREND continuation). Watch AAPL support at recent 1W lows given BELOW TREND status. Track ORCL for follow-through on bullish headlines vs its BELOW TREND price action.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
ORCL (+50): Oracle expands into defense/healthcare—price BELOW TREND (1W: -16.93% | 1M: -21.03%) so news diverges from price; watch for accumulation. XOM (+60): Supreme Court development supportive—XOM BELOW TREND (1W: -2.27% | 1M: -8.18%) so sentiment positive but price lagging. DE (+80): Deere guidance/AI buyback headline—CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.58% | 1M: +16.34%) offers a related industrial read-through.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
AAPL (-40): FT report on CHIPS sourcing raises concerns and price is BELOW TREND (1W: -7.03% | 1M: -10.76%)—news confirms weakness. AMGN (-80): regulatory headwind flagged in headlines—monitor for price reaction (regulatory risk). SO (-50): lowered target in utilities sector—watch utility names for follow-through given mixed sector flow.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Value/Cyclical tilt. DD, AMAT, CAT, ABBV ABOVE TREND are current relative strength leaders. Key risk is the MAJOR divergence among mega-cap Tech (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, GOOGL, META, AMZN, TSLA all BELOW TREND) and scattered news-price divergences (e.g., ORCL bullish headlines but price BELOW TREND).
